# CVE overrides for the vendored upstream lock (requirements.txt), with the
# hash of every distribution file (uv pip compile --no-deps --generate-hashes).
# Installed after the lock with --no-deps, so uv replaces the locked
# distribution in place and the venv keeps one dist-info per name. The
# lock-drift guard in build-ascender.sh reads only requirements.txt, so the
# lock keeps upstream's pins and the overrides live here. Drop a line once the
# upstream lock carries the same or a newer version.
# click 8.1.7 -> 8.3.3 and receptorctl 1.6.4 -> 1.6.8, moved together as on
# upstream main in
# https://github.com/ctrliq/ascender/commit/062416d55b97930edada6da7a1be497db9bc4b44
click==8.3.3 \
    --hash=sha256:398329ad4837b2ff7cbe1dd166a4c0f8900c3ca3a218de04466f38f6497f18a2 \
    --hash=sha256:a2bf429bb3033c89fa4936ffb35d5cb471e3719e1f3c8a7c3fff0b8314305613
# receptorctl 1.6.4 pins click<8.2.0 and 1.6.8 pins click>=8.3.3,<8.4.0, so it moves with click.
receptorctl==1.6.8 \
    --hash=sha256:0b0b0fe33b0734d1beed83dd57d1f8d0115e96fba63791f8d86e4925714c34ef \
    --hash=sha256:ffb05a28df434477f13e5152bad6d6f7230dd304a93adef3c0ae55873a2ee3e2
